sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was reduced: organic revenue growth guidance was lowered from 'approximately 4 percent' to 'a low-single-digit increase'. Management explicitly cited 'subdued category performance trends in North America' and 'business disruptions due to rising geopolitical tensions in certain international markets'. The EPS guidance was reaffirmed but the revenue cut is a material negative signal for forward expectations.

summary.revenue: Reported net revenue of $23,319 million for Q3 2024, a decrease of 0.6% year-over-year. Organic revenue growth was 1.3%.
summary.eps: Reported GAAP EPS of $2.13, a decrease of 5% year-over-year. Core constant currency EPS increased 5%.
summary.guidance: Full-year 2024 organic revenue growth guidance lowered to 'a low-single-digit increase' from 'approximately 4 percent'. Core constant currency EPS growth guidance reaffirmed at 'at least 8 percent'.
summary.margin: Not disclosed in a single consolidated figure. The document shows a reported operating margin decline of 51 bps for the 12 weeks ended September 7, 2024, but core operating margin growth was 10 bps.
key_risks: Subdued category performance trends in North America
Continued impacts related to certain recalls at Quaker Foods North America
Business disruptions due to rising geopolitical tensions in certain international markets
Foreign exchange translation headwind of approximately 1 percentage point on reported net revenue and core EPS growth
key_opportunities: Incremental investments to improve marketplace competitiveness
Productivity initiatives across the entire organization
Long-term growth potential in snacks and beverage categories globally
